record.original_question: Develop a solution theory for the d-bar Neumann problem in Sobolev spaces H^s.

evidence.quote: Problem 6.1.1 Solve the ∂¯ Neumann problem in H s .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a bounded pseudoconvex domain with smooth boundary, and for $0 \le q \le n$ let $L^2_{(0,q)}(\Omega)$ denote the Hilbert space of $(0,q)$-forms on $\Omega$ with $L^2$ coefficients. Define the maximal closed extension $\bar{\partial} : L^2_{(0,q)}(\Omega) \to L^2_{(0,q+1)}(\Omega)$ of the Cauchy–Riemann operator, together with its Hilbert space adjoint $\bar{\partial}^{*}$. The complex Laplacian on $(0,q)$-forms is
$$\Box_q \; = \; \bar{\partial}\,\bar{\partial}^{*} \;+\; \bar{\partial}^{*}\,\bar{\partial},$$
and the $\bar{\partial}$-Neumann problem on $(0,q)$-forms (for $1 \le q \le n$) asks, given $\alpha \in L^2_{(0,q)}(\Omega)$ orthogonal to the harmonic forms, to find $u \in \mathrm{Dom}(\Box_q)$ with $\Box_q u = \alpha$, where the boundary conditions $u \in \mathrm{Dom}(\bar{\partial}^{*})$ and $\bar{\partial} u \in \mathrm{Dom}(\bar{\partial}^{*})$ are imposed.

For a real number $s \ge 0$, let $H^s_{(0,q)}(\Omega)$ denote the Sobolev space of $(0,q)$-forms with coefficients in $H^s(\Omega)$.

Develop a solution theory for the $\bar{\partial}$-Neumann problem in the scale of Sobolev spaces $H^s$. Specifically:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item Characterize those bounded pseudoconvex domains $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ with smooth boundary for which the $\bar{\partial}$-Neumann operator $N_q = \Box_q^{-1}$ (on the orthogonal complement of the harmonic space) maps $H^s_{(0,q)}(\Omega)$ continuously to itself for every $s \ge 0$.
    \item Establish sharp Sobolev regularity estimates of the form $\|N_q \alpha\|_{H^s} \le C_s \|\alpha\|_{H^s}$, and identify the geometric or potential-theoretic conditions on $\partial\Omega$ that govern such estimates.
\end{enumerate}
artifact.status_search_result: The $L^2$ existence theory on bounded pseudoconvex domains and $C^\infty$ regularity up to the boundary on smooth bounded strongly pseudoconvex domains were established in the 1960s, with subelliptic $H^s$ estimates known on finite-type domains. However, global $H^s$ regularity is known to fail on some smooth weakly pseudoconvex domains (e.g., Barrett's and the worm domains), and a complete characterization of domains on which $N_q$ is globally regular in all $H^s$ remains an active area of research.

status_evidence.title: Global Regularity of the ∂-Neumann Problem: A Survey of the L2-Sobolev Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Global regularity of the ∂-Neumann problem is discussed in the L2-Sobolev spaces Ws(Ω) for all non-negative s. ... global regularity up to the boundary fails in some smooth, bounded, weakly pseudoconvex domains.
status_evidence.claim: Sobolev regularity of the d-bar Neumann problem is partially understood: positive results on strongly pseudoconvex and finite-type domains, but failures on some weakly pseudoconvex domains, and the general theory continues to be developed.

status_evidence.title: The d-bar-Neumann Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Research on compactness and regularity of the d-bar Neumann operator on pseudoconvex domains.
status_evidence.claim: The d-bar Neumann problem remains an active research area, particularly concerning Sobolev regularity and compactness.
